summary: The brand states online advance sales from 18 November and phased Japan store sales from 25 November. This records the announced rollout schedule; branch-level stock has not been checked.

title: Samsonite reports Q3 2026 results
summary: For July–September 2026, worldwide group net sales were USD 872.7 million, flat year over year in reported dollars and up 0.6% at constant currency. Travel-category revenue was USD 555.6 million, down 1.1% reported and 0.5% at constant currency. These are company/category revenues, not unit sales, retailer rankings or model popularity.

title: RIMOWA extends wheel and handle customization to Original
summary: RIMOWA dates worldwide availability to November 4. The EUR 135 wheel sets use a T20 screwdriver. D50 fits Original Compact, Pilot and Cabin sizes. D65 fits Original Check-in and Trunk. The EUR 250 handle set for Original Silver Cabin, Check-in and Trunk requires specialist installation in store.

title: Nordstrom lists American Dreamliner Navy carry-on at USD 42.49
summary: Nordstrom shows USD 42.49 and a previous price of USD 49.99 for one Navy 22.5-inch carry-on. Concept One Accessories is the marketplace seller. Launch date and promotion period are unverified.

title: BAGSMART Getaway carry-on listed at USD 127.99
summary: The US storefront displayed USD 127.99 for 12 saved 20-inch Getaway color variants on November 16. Their November 8 observation was USD 143.99. Promotion start and end dates are unknown.

title: Travelpro Roundtrip underseater listed at USD 99.99 in four colors
summary: Travelpro showed USD 99.99 for Black, Navy, Olive Green and Ash Lilac. The Black SKU was previously observed at USD 140 on November 8. The storefront listing dates to September 3, 2024. The launch date is unknown.

title: Samsonite Group reports nine-month results
summary: Worldwide net sales for January–September 2026 were USD 2,553.3 million across travel and lifestyle products. The travel category accounted for USD 1,608.2 million, down 0.9% year over year in reported currency.

title: Katie Loxton lists its first Avora hard-shell cases in the UK
summary: The official UK collection links four exact Avora offers: Black and Off White in cabin (GBP 199.99) and large (GBP 249.99). Exact pages provide SKUs, weights and features but publish conflicting dimension fields. November 17 is the Atlas first-observation date; the brand gives no calendar launch date.

title: Travelpro highlights limited-edition Gloss Red Platinum Elite Hardside
summary: The official campaign spotlights Gloss Red carry-on and medium check-in cases. Their USD 380 and USD 430 Atlas price observations remain dated 8 November; the official storefront listing date is 2 November. Exact exterior/interior views and dimensions were verified 24 November. The product launch date is not stated.
